title: A/P Detail lines keep their information and location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has an unpaid bill received at location B.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Find vendor Y's bill.
  5. Read the whole line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • date, "Invoice", the bill No., vendor Y's name, location B, due date, Past Due, Amount and Open Balance.

Why this matters: Each payables line must still say what, to whom, where and how much.
